Title: VTES Online World Championship 2020 via lackey and discord-rules and report

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
VTES Online World Championship 2020 via lackey and discord

LackeyCCG presents you the VTES Online World Championship 2020:
You can engage in 6 weeks of merciless slaughter to crown yourself Champion.
English language usable.
Games be played with lackey and discord.

Format:
Best 3 games out of 6 (6 games is maximum for every player) possible will be counted.
Self-organized game are allowed(players can play more games during one week,exept last week,then is allowed only 1 game)

Multi deck system (you can play a different deck each game).

Time limit: 5 player table 2,5h and 4 player table 2h.

World Final:
Saturday, 28th November 2020. (start time will vary depending on finalists)
English language talk in finals.
Note: The 5 best players will go to the finals. Seating in finals is random!
1st deck load in finals 5th seed,and top seed load deck last
Players can chose any deck in finals,even if this deck dont play earlier during competion.
Tie for finals: if 2 players tie in 3 best games then be watched if they play same number games,if play same number then we compare best 4th game,best 5th game and best 6th.
if still tie,they they roll dice,small number get beter place for finals.
If 2 player have diferent number games,then they roll dice for tie.
If 3 or more players have tie for finals they they all roll dice.

Prize Support from Black Chantry:
V5 box for winner + prizes for another 4 finalists.

Organizers
Igor Beslin () Lackey name: Beslin Igor-Europe zone
Rudolf Scholz Lackey name: The Bard-Europe zone
Joab Rogeiro-Brazil zone
Alex Nava-Mexico zone

Registration
Tell one of the organizers that you want to play for this day, either on Lackey or contact us on social media.
Connect to Lackey approximately 1 hour before the start time.
Registrations are closed 15min prior start time.

New expansion V5 not be allowed in championship.

log modificator aded to coeficient in finals for rating is 1

First criteria in unique tabela is GW then VP,if there be tie,I explain rule in world finals part.

PLAYERS READ:
players can mix zones,so can play in more zones than one,but must meet the requirements of admins - for example the language of communication in that zone or any other stuff.
All results be in one tabela,so we have unique tabela,best 5 in tabela play finals.
So can be 5 players in finals from one zone,or can be 5 players all from diferent zones,all depends of 3 best games(3 best results)

How to start games:
a) admins set tables random for current round
b) first name host table and other players join in game
c) every player load deck
d) every player rool d20 for seat,smaller number play 1st
e) set timer and start games

In case self organize game,player who organize game host table and when players join they use c and d and e from above.

Timer pause:
timer pause work in 2 case:
if players need to find rules or call judge
if someone lose conections,timer is stoped until game back in moment when player lose conection.
player who lose conection have 15 mins to back in game,if him no back game continue on next way: all his cards stay in play and him need to pay every efect in play.
his minions no act,no block,no votes,but they can be target another player steal or rushes or votes,this player lose 4 pool in every influence phase until him be ousted.
then his prey gain 1VP and 6 pool

VTES Online World Championship start in friday with self organize game
We have 4 organizing termins for now,Yosha self organize games,Europe zones,Brazil zones and Mexico zones
So Online World Championship be opened with Yosha self organize game in friday(16th oct)
Yosha open table in lackey in 19:30,game start in 20h. so Yosha organize games every next 6 fridays in 20h (16,23 and 30 oct,6,13 and 20 nov)
Games in Europe zone start in sunday in 20:30h CET . Igor with assistant Rudolf organize Europe zone every 6 next sundays(18 and 25 oct,1,8,15 and 22 nov)
Games in Brazil zone organize Joab,comuniti in Brazil zone is only portugese language. Games be played in sundays and be played 2 rounds every time,1st game start in 14h Brazil time,and 2nd game start in 17h Brazil time. dates: 18 oct(round 1 and 2),25 oct(round 3 and 4), 8 nov (round 5 and 6)
Mexico zone organize Alex Nava every next 6 mondays(19 and 26 oct,2,9,16 and 23 nov),games start in 8:30pm Mexico time.
Edit 05 november: If someone cannot play games in these schedule dates him can tru play self organize game every another day when can get 4 or 5 players in table. players can play more games during week exept last week,so starting from thursday 19th nov to 23 nov players can play only 1 game,so 23th nov is last day for qualifications,24th nov,we determine 5 finalist.

Welcome and good luck everyone

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
VTES Online World Championship 2020

Today continue Europe zone in 20:30 CET,pls everyone read,we need to ask to everyone online players register in hook page and connect his user profile with player profile,in text we explain all:

We have to inform you about some changes, we will do in the next steps.

And therefore we need your cooperation.

In the past, we had some problems to identify single users or get in contact with them. (Switching Lackey names, misspelling Lackey names or emails)

And so we decided, that we need some unique personal data from all players who want to participate in the online ranking and online championship to get unique contacts.
(eG. Name, VEKN and Email)

But to get, data like this, this is not an easy task today.

There is some regulation, that doesn't allow us to do this for you, by calling. (GDPR (For Eu citizens) and CCPA (US-California citizens) and some other not specified)
But we need to ask every player who participates in online events and especially the current VTES Online World Championship league to make register on hook page:
www.vtes-hook.com/component/users/...

And connect his user name with his player name.

So every player register with a real name needs to have his user name, vekn ID, and need to connect with his player name. AND (that is important for communication and some price supports) allow us to share game details and your contact data with BCP! Without this permission, you can't participate in some special Events with price support from BCP. (Or other stuff that will be supported by BCP. If you are not interested you can participate at the event but your name will not be submitted to BCP and you can't get any prize-support from BCP)

After registration, every player needs to find his player name on the hook page (please choose the same name as lackey name). Then connect your user profile with your player profile, check if your country also.

This video can help, because oft he GDPR is a matching and account creation with „publishing“ of data not so easy:

If you can't find your name or have problems please contact Kai ( or discord id => blackkowl#7655) or Igor (discord id=> Beslin Igor#6550)
Normally your name should be found in a List at the bottom of your "User Control Panel" (UCP). Please check there, your vekn number also!

Important to all already registered players, we will send one login reminder to all of you who are already registered at vtes-hook. Because we want to make sure. That you have entered your correct data and connected your account and set the correct vekn number.
If you are not interested, please ignore it or ask to cancel your user account.

Also important to all of you who are already or will register:
Always when publishing any results from the hook page we will publish it with hook/lackey name, your real names don't be published or shared with "not permitted" other third party's. (except for people who use real names in lackey (by himself).

If you want to change your Lackey name (at hook page) please contact Igor or Kai).
We are sorry that we have to do that, but otherwise, it is not possible to manage those events.

Many thanks for your cooperation.
Stay safe and healthy.

Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
Here is the report from the 2020 World Online Championship final round.
Player 1: Joab Roger, 4th seed, Anarchs with Animalism rush
Player 2: Faroock, 1st seed, DOM/OBT Bruise/bleed toolbox
Player 3: BartDCI, 3rd seed, Cybele/Girls Ashur
Player 4: Menteith, 2nd seed, Guruhi+Ani weenie bleed/toolbox
Player 5: Killiam, 5th seed, Tupdog Legionnaires

Results: Killiam (Bill Troxel) GW with 2.5 VP
BartDCI: 0.5VP
Menteith: 0.5VP

Joab removed a lot of counters from the game with Smiling Jack and 2 Anarch Revolts early on. Jack accumulated 4 counters before it was destroyed by Farook with the help of Shadow Body. Faroock had brought out Lord Leopold Valdemar (Priscus), so did not have the option to go Anarch and suffered heavily. Bart decrypted an Anarch Convert, and Menteith was also able to get an Anarch in his ready region. Killiam with a pure Tupdog crypt took the full brunt of the damage. Once Faroock had Lord Leopold ready with vote lock, Killiam took the actions to remove the Revolts.

Joab played aggressively, bleeding frequently with Deep Song. Faroock needed a second minion and brought out Badr, Shadow of Grenada, bringing himself down to 1 pool! Joab then played an Anarch Revolt, which would have ended Faroock had he not had a Vessel on Lord Valdemar. Joab holds on for another turn, then Governs down with Badr and scoops back a couple more pool.

Meanwhile, Killiam had started going forward with his Emerald Legionnaires and was making a dent in Joab. Killiam had made a terrible mistake in his third turn by forgetting to bring up two Legionnaires during his unlock phase, so he was a couple bleeds behind. Fortunately for Killiam, he had suffered virtually no early or mid-game pressure from his predator Menteith, whose deck appeared to be designed as more of a late-game swarm, so Killiam was able to just barely oust Joab with his final bleed before Joab could oust his prey.

With Joab out, Faroock at 3 pool, and Killiam finally sporting a large army of allies, the second VP for Killiam was inevitable.

Meanwhile, BartDCI had finally brought out his star vampire, Cybele. He had to dig into his crypt for her, and also had to Golconda Nana Buruku in order to afford her. He was fairly low on pool, so it looked like Killiam would have a reasonable shot at ousting him with all his allies.

Down to three players, Bart and Menteith form an alliance to oust Killiam, such that Bart would bloat with masters and put no pressure on Menteith, while Menteith accumulated an army of weenies and equipment that was truly frightful. After a lot of Founders of the Ebony Kingdom, Guruhi are the Land (GATL), and a Codex of the Edenic Groundskeepers, it was clear that if Killiam ever got fully tapped out, he would be vulnerable to an oust.

Killiam played aggressively for awhile trying to secure that 3rd victory point, but after some run-ins with Menteith's Laibon and their Animalism combat, his numbers began to dwindle. When Bart pulled a Villein into his hand upon popping a set of Ashur Tablets, Killiam's prospects for ousting Bart looked bleak.

Eventually it got to where Menteith might only need a good 2 or 3 turns to oust his prey, maybe 3 or 4 if Killiam walled up---although if Killiam were ever to tap out, a single turn of Darby-dancing the Codex with GATL would have done it. However, by that time the clock only had about 15 minutes left on it, and BartDCI was playing very methodically, with his turns lasting a while. Killiam ultimately decided to fully wall up, taking no further forward actions, and Menteith only got to see 1 of the turns he needed before the game timed out. Killiam took the game 2.5 - 0.5 - 0.5.

-Killiam

And the strangest things seem
Suddenly routine"
